# Instructions for accurately documenting failed building fire-safety checks

1. Start with the inspection records.
2.
completion:
Find any failed inspections. 3. Find the fire-safety sub-categories and sub-sub-categories failed in each inspection. 4. The format of the results is as desired. # Building fire-safety inspections at first look The platform collects fire-safety inspection records from multiple cities.
A single record contains the following fields: - Building name and address where the inspection took place - The number of the inspection - Date of inspection - Inspection result - boolean It makes up to 8 million records in different cities for 10+ years.
Here’s a visualization of number of building inspections over time:
![Pr. Inspection by year](images/by_year.jpeg)
Number of building inspections / year

Now we would like to investigate deeper into the inspections and make sure that building owners deal with fire-safety
